sections.bio:
I am a passionate technology enthusiast currently pursuing MCA (Generative AI) with a strong interest in software development and data-driven technologies. I enjoy learning new technologies and applying them to solve real-world problems.

I have hands-on experience in Web Development and Programming, with skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, and MySQL. I also have knowledge in Data Structures, Data Science, and Machine Learning, which helps me understand both software development and data-driven solutions.

Through my academic projects and internships, I have developed problem-solving abilities, logical thinking, and practical technical skills. I am always eager to learn new tools and technologies that can help me grow as a developer and data professional.

I am currently seeking opportunities to apply my skills, gain industry experience, and contribute to innovative technology solutions.

posts.text:
🚀 Excited to share a new milestone in my Generative AI journey!
I’m happy to share that I received a Certificate of Participation for ViCoDathon 2026 – India’s AI Vibe Coding Hackathon, presented by AB Talks.
As part of the hackathon, I built an AI Interview Agent designed to conduct personalized, multi-turn interviews and adapt questions based on the candidate’s profile, skills, and responses. 🤖💬
Through this experience, I explored Generative AI, AI-powered application development, prompt engineering, adaptive conversations, and vibe coding, while turning an idea into a working application.
🔗 GitHubRepository:
      https://lnkd.in/dXHKRwsM
🌐 Live Demo: https://lnkd.in/dq7ac9NA
Grateful to Anil Bajpai for organizing this incredible hackathon and to ABTalksOnAI for creating a platform that gave us the opportunity to learn, build, experiment, and innovate. 🙌
As an MCA Generative AI student at Alliance University, experiences like these are helping me bridge the gap between learning AI concepts and building real-world AI applications. 🎓🤖
Grateful to AB Talks for this opportunity and looking forward to taking on more challenges and building impactful solutions with AI! 🚀
#ViCoDathon2026 #ABTalks #AllianceUniversity #AIInterviewAgent #GenerativeAI #ArtificialIntelligence #VibeCoding #Hackathon #AI #PromptEngineering #GitHub #Innovation #MCA #DeveloperJourney

I am pleased to share that I have successfully completed the Quantum Computing Fundamentals certification through IBM SkillsBuild.
This course provided me with a strong foundation in quantum computing, covering its core concepts, real-world applications, and an introduction to the Qiskit framework for quantum programming. It also offered valuable insights into how quantum computing is shaping the future of artificial intelligence, optimization, and scientific research.
As an MCA (Generative AI) student, I am committed to continuously expanding my knowledge of emerging technologies and building the skills needed to contribute to the next generation of intelligent computing.
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Alliance University, 1M1B (One Million for One Billion), and IBM SkillsBuild for providing this valuable learning opportunity.
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Ajiith Pandian sir for encouraging me to attend this insightful webinar, and to Guncha Malik mam for delivering an engaging session and sharing valuable knowledge on Quantum Computing.
I look forward to exploring more advanced concepts in quantum computing and applying them in future AI and technology projects.
#QuantumComputing #Qiskit #IBMSkillsBuild #IBM #ArtificialIntelligence #GenerativeAI #ContinuousLearning #FutureTech #AllianceUniversity #1M1B #ProfessionalDevelopment

Happy to share that I received a Participant Certificate for participating in the Tech Titan, Trivia & Pictionary Face-Off 2026.

It was an exciting experience that challenged my technical knowledge, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving skills. Participating in events like these motivates me to continue learning, collaborating, and growing as a technology professional.

A heartfelt thank you to Alliance University and Dell Technologies for organizing this engaging event and providing students with an opportunity to learn beyond the classroom.

A special thanks to my amazing teammates for their collaboration, support, and enthusiasm throughout the event. It was a pleasure working with all of you. Looking forward to many more such experiences together!

Team: Brithi S Bhumika H S Priyansh Nolkha

#AllianceUniversity #DellTechnologies #TechTitan #Trivia #Pictionary #MCA #GenerativeAI #Teamwork #Innovation #Technology #ContinuousLearning

🚀 Excited to share my latest project: CrewAI Role-Based AI Interviewer 🎙️🤖
I developed an AI-powered mock interview simulator using CrewAI, Streamlit, and GPT-4o-mini that helps candidates prepare for interviews with role-specific questions and instant feedback.
✨ Key Features:
✅ Supports multiple roles including Data Scientist, Web Developer, Product Manager, and UI/UX Designer
✅ AI-powered feedback using CrewAI agents and GPT-4o-mini
✅ Demo Mode that works without an API key
✅ Interactive dark-themed UI with progress tracking and answer analytics
✅ Comprehensive interview summary and performance review
🛠️ Technologies Used:
🔹 Python
🔹 Streamlit
🔹 CrewAI
🔹 OpenAI GPT-4o-mini
🔹 LangChain
🔹 Python Dotenv
This project provided valuable hands-on experience in:
🔹 Multi-agent AI systems using CrewAI
🔹 Prompt engineering and LLM integration
🔹 Building practical Generative AI applications
🔹 Designing interactive user experiences with Streamlit
I am grateful to Alliance University for providing opportunities and an environment that encourages innovation and practical learning in AI and emerging technologies.
📌 GitHub Repository: https://lnkd.in/gKbHeWjN
📷 Project screenshot showcasing the role selection interface, interview workflow, AI-generated feedback, and final performance summary are attached below.
#GenerativeAI #CrewAI #OpenAI #GPT4oMini #Streamlit #Python #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #DataScience #SoftwareDevelopment #AIProjects #InterviewPreparation #LLM #Innovation #AllianceUniversity

Grateful to share an important milestone in my journey. Being a part of Alliance University has helped me grow academically, professionally, and personally through valuable learning experiences and opportunities.
I would like to express my heartfelt respect and gratitude to Ajiith Pandian sir for the constant guidance, support, and encouragement throughout my journey. Your mentorship, valuable advice, and belief in my potential truly inspired me to keep learning and improving every day.
I am also thankful for the opportunity to be associated with the 1M1B initiative, which provided meaningful exposure toward leadership, innovation, and career development.
Looking forward to new opportunities, continuous learning, and contributing positively wherever I go.
#AllianceUniversity #1M1B #Gratitude #Mentorship #ProfessionalGrowth #CareerDevelopment
